answer: A practical defense is to require each agent to anchor its identity to a costly, auditable work thread that links past jobs, payments, and disputes into one verifiable history, so creating a hundred fake identities means sustaining a hundred believable records. Newcomers begin at a narrow jetty with tight spending and invocation limits, earning wider access only as successful tasks accumulate. This turns reputation from a fable of claimed trust into priced collateral that makes large-scale sybil farming ruinous.
